text.tspan: A contract has no private key. ERC-1271 lets it declare a signature valid, but USDC never asks —
it recovers an address from v, r, s and compares. So the account holding USDC must be an EOA.

text.tspan: What this means for the SDK

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: · The EOA holds USDC and signs every payment.
· The smart account is used for everything that is not an EIP-3009 transfer.
· Routing payments through a UserOp instead is a Phase 2 investigation, not a v0.1 problem.
